dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Presence of multiple prominent closed 'O' and open 'C' shaped annuli along the lateral flank. A distinct elliptical 'O' structure on the upper posterior region features a sharp dark-to-light gradient transition from the outer rim inward. More ventral annuli exhibit irregular, wavy exterior perimeters with localized variations in rim thickness.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Sparse distribution of localized low-intensity (dark) pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily situated in the anterior-lateral region and between larger macro-annuli. High-intensity pixel concentrations are confined to the internal centers of annuli rather than forming independent solid blobs.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Geometric relationships formed by the centroids of the five most prominent posterior annuli describe a complex polygon with two nearly parallel horizontal axes. The three largest posterior annuli form a primary triangular cluster on the flank.
